subtitles.en: the developments that we're hearing when it comes to how Beijing is approaching some of these possible curbs from their companies as well as that broader theme of AI investors just turning more discerning
subtitles.zh: 我们听到关于北京如何应对企业可能面临的限制，以及AI主题下投资者变得更加挑剔的进展。

subtitles.en: we've seen that sort of cashing out of some very crowded trades widening the search for more undervalued opportunities they're getting harder to find
subtitles.zh: 我们看到一些拥挤交易被获利了结，投资者在寻找更低估的机会，但这类机会越来越难找。

subtitles.en: let's bring now from Singapore Kristie Tan has a global investment strategist at Franklin Templeton Institute and Kristie really great to have you with us so we are seeing a day where geopolitical tensions the revival of these concerns and oil now back in the spotlight as well as broader inflation concerns are now top of mind
subtitles.zh: 现在连线新加坡的Kristie Tan，她是富兰克林坦伯顿研究所的全球市场策略师。今天我们看到地缘政治紧张局势重燃，油价重回焦点，通胀担忧也成为市场核心议题。

subtitles.en: is this something that investors have been pretty happy to shrug off today but is it something that now creates that risk for rally that is already looking very very hated so that's an interesting question
subtitles.zh: 投资者今天似乎对这些风险不以为意，但这是否会给已经备受质疑的反弹带来风险？这是个有趣的问题。

subtitles.en: I think we started a year saying that you know the markets were probably broadened out and the equity markets concentration has been one of the key themes observed and this AI and KPACs and earnings momentum has kept you know markets and investors buffered against all the shocks
subtitles.zh: 我认为年初我们就提到市场可能会扩散，权益市场集中度一直是关键主题。AI、资本支出和盈利动能让市场和投资者抵御了各种冲击。

subtitles.en: that's coming from the geopolitics and the oil situation as well as inflation risks but I think you're probably right that you know geopolitics continue to be one of the key themes and one of the key concerns that a lot of investors especially medium term ones are still very very focused on
subtitles.zh: 这些冲击来自地缘政治、油价和通胀风险。但你说得对，地缘政治仍是关键主题，许多投资者，尤其是中期投资者，仍然高度关注。

subtitles.en: and this will drive you know the kind of inflation profile which recently we've seen the fall in oil prices and we thought that you know because of the US Iran situation and cease fire but obviously that is not something that is very concrete in fact it is a shaky ceasefire and an MOU is not a deal so the peace deal I think is still in question and that brings about continued overall concerns especially in the geopolitics front
subtitles.zh: 这将影响通胀走势。近期油价下跌，我们曾认为是因为美伊局势和停火，但显然停火并不稳固，谅解备忘录不等于协议，和平协议仍存疑，这持续引发整体担忧，尤其是地缘政治方面。

subtitles.en: on the other hand if you're looking at the AI trade and the concentration risk and now there are increasing concerns of whether or not this volatility induced will also lead to you know these structural questions on whether or not the KPACs as expenditures where the funding from and how this can continue to support earnings going forward
subtitles.zh: 另一方面，AI交易和集中度风险引发担忧：这种波动是否会带来结构性问题，比如资本支出的资金来源，以及如何持续支撑未来盈利。

subtitles.en: so I think it's a combination of some of the existing concerns with regards to geopolitics that is really still not something that is absolutely priced in and then at the same time we're looking at the continued I think talks about the concentration risks where the fundings keep at funding are coming from and also whether earnings momentum will continue
subtitles.zh: 我认为这是现有担忧的组合：地缘政治风险尚未完全定价，同时集中度风险、资金来源以及盈利动能能否持续仍是焦点。

subtitles.en: so overall I think the macro data has shown that economy is resilient Christie to your point about the resilient economy how much does the inflation profile as you highlighted actually matter for tech stocks in the second half we saw in the first half how things were really driven by momentum
subtitles.zh: 总体而言，宏观数据显示经济具有韧性。关于韧性经济，你提到的通胀状况对下半年科技股影响有多大？上半年市场主要由动能驱动。

subtitles.en: I mean this week yeah we are seeing that telling what are you assessing overall when it comes to the growth that we're rating that we've been seeing for much of this year in South Korea Taiwan markets in particular
subtitles.zh: 本周我们看到的情况说明了什么？你如何评估今年韩国、台湾等市场所见的增长？

subtitles.en: so in Asia the inflation themes probably came about quite meaningfully because essentially Asia largely a large importer of oil so that inflation profile I think inflation risks does manifest quite visibly in especially in Asia and then on the other hand the AI story in Asia is it's quite different from the one in the US right
subtitles.zh: 在亚洲，通胀主题可能更为显著，因为亚洲是石油主要进口地区，通胀风险在亚洲表现得尤为明显。另一方面，亚洲的AI故事与美国截然不同。

subtitles.en: so we're looking at especially Korea I mean Korea is a very clean expression of the AI memory and semiconductor cycle and so when positioning becomes crowded volatility also rises and the added issue in Korea is leverage right
subtitles.zh: 特别是韩国，它是AI存储和半导体周期的典型代表。当仓位变得拥挤，波动率就会上升，而韩国还有一个额外问题——杠杆。

subtitles.en: so we're seeing that leverage single stock products can force same direction flows so buying to rallies and selling to declines which can amplify market moves especially when liquidity is not ample
subtitles.zh: 我们看到杠杆单一股票产品会引发同向资金流，追涨杀跌，从而放大市场波动，尤其是在流动性不足时。

subtitles.en: so I think at this point in time it's not just whether the fundamental story is attractive which we think it is the question is whether liquidity and position can absorb the flows
subtitles.zh: 因此目前的问题不仅是基本面故事是否吸引人（我们认为是的），而是流动性和仓位能否吸收这些资金流。

subtitles.en: and so how do we relate that to that inflation profile in Asia is that we are seeing a lot more tightness in I think policy direction so we're seeing you know Indonesia hiking rates and the other central banks including RBNZ are probably going to you know tighten policy to deal with the inflation risk
subtitles.zh: 这与亚洲通胀状况的关联在于，我们看到政策方向趋紧，印尼加息，其他央行如新西兰联储也可能收紧政策以应对通胀风险。

subtitles.en: and this comes at a time Chris when there's a lot of volatility in the equity markets as well Chris they wanted to dig a bit deeper into your views on South Korea because you say you know there's obviously the danger of just buying the index on the AI story which a lot of investors have done and it's a very compelling so right also a danger you say in looking our companies like Samsung and high necks with its ADR listing as well as a proxy for the South Korean markets
subtitles.zh: 而此时权益市场本身波动也很大。主持人想进一步了解你对韩国的看法，因为你说很多投资者仅因AI故事就买入指数，这很诱人但也有风险，包括将三星、SK海力士等公司视为韩国市场代表的风险。

subtitles.en: so how do you trade this market where are the opportunities and I guess the value that you can still find so a potential US listing would speak to global investor demand for AI supply chain exposure and deeper capital market access beyond the max seven but you know it does not remove the underlying cyclicality of semiconductors memory pricing or even concentration risks
subtitles.zh: 那么如何交易这个市场？机会和价值在哪里？潜在的美国上市反映了全球投资者对AI供应链敞口和更深入资本市场准入的需求，但这并未消除半导体、存储定价的周期性，甚至集中度风险。
